newsitem.title: USA: Atlanta Tech sees Q3, Q4 revs above Q1.
newsitem.headline: Atlanta Tech sees Q3, Q4 revs above Q1.

text.p: Atlanta Technology Group Inc said on Thursday that third and fourth quarter revenues would surpass the first quarter's, reflecting the launch of a new Spanish language software product.

The software, called Documentplus, is designed to help healthcare providers cut down on time spent on correspondence to attorneys and insurance companies. Atlanta Technology had $413,000 in sales during the first quarter of 1997.
The company reported second quarter net income of $54,491, or $0.01 per share, compared with a loss of $66,019, or $0.02 per share, for the year-ago period.
